android.desc:
Experience one of the best 3D cricket games on mobile, featuring realistic gameplay, stunning stadiums, and authentic cricket action. Play exciting matches across formats including ODI, 20-20, and Test, compete in global tournaments, and enjoy a complete cricket game experience in Epic Cricket.

Epic Cricket is crafted with passion for true cricket fans. Immerse yourself in authentic cricket action and experience the thrill of major international tournaments and competitive matches across multiple formats.

Play Epic Cricket as an offline cricket game anytime or compete online in exciting cricket matches, global tournaments, and thrilling cricket league seasons.

SPECIAL FEATURES OF THIS 3D CRICKET GAME
+ 20 international cricket teams
+ Featuring 15+ international and domestic league tournaments
+ Real-Time Multiplayer
+ Play and Chat with Friends
+ Live Events
+ Live Player Auction (ECPL)
+ Super Over
+ Stunning Stadiums
+ All major formats of cricket – ODI, 20-20, and Test matches
+ 500+ authentic and fluid gameplay animations
+ Dynamic broadcast camera angles
+ Real-time slow motion replays
+ Cinematic match cutscenes
+ Live commentary in English and Hindi
+ Versatile animations for batting, bowling, and fielding
+ Ultra-high FPS game mode
+ Realistic reactions from captains, wicket-keepers, and batsmen
+ Modern batting and bowling styles
+ Players with unique abilities like real cricket superstars
+ Large team squads to build your ultimate cricket team

The game offers a complete cricket experience for fans around the world, featuring all major international formats including ODI (One Day International), 20-20 matches with fast-paced 20-over gameplay, and Test Matches, the longest and most strategic format of cricket.

In the game, you can compete in a wide range of world-class cricket tournaments, including exciting India 20-20 style league competitions and major global championships such as the 20-20 International League, ODI Cricket Championship, and premier Test tournaments such as the Global Test Championship. Choose your team, compete across formats, and lead your squad to international glory.

You can also play cricket rivalries such as India vs Pakistan or England vs Australia that you can create in Custom Tour. Create your own ODI, 20-20 or Test series and choose your team be it India, England, Australia, Pakistan, Bangladesh or any other country you like to play.

The game delivers a complete 3D cricket game
